name: Bloodmage mortal abilities carry the internal cursed form exclusion in the client data (#5737, #6394)
contract: The client's own Spell.dbc excludes the Mortal Form abilities (Bloodmoon Blast, Vampyr's Kiss,
Keleseth's Calamity, Valanar's Vengeance, Sanguine Rupture, Taldaram's Torment) with
ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 524861, the marker every Cursed Form sets, so the client greys them under
Sanguine Essence 680692 and Transgression 801076 as well; the tooltips carry the same
$?a524861[...]Requires Mortal Form|r line, 47 ranks in total. AscensionCompat rewrites the exclusion
field and the tooltip text to the internal marker 802877, which SyncCursedFormRequirement applies only
for the restricting Cursed Forms; the client receives that rewrite through its baked Spell.dbc rows,
which were once gated behind ClientSpellPatches registration that only Running
Wild had. A client row holds the DBC record's fields first, and ExcludeCasterAuraSpell is field 26, so a
client row must carry 802877 at index 26. This scenario asserts that for the first rank of each
chain, with row 500639 (Runeshroud) and the rewritten text of 500125 as controls. Expected before the
registration: none of the six rows carries the marker. After: each carries the internal marker. A second, larger set
of mortal abilities (Mend, Crimson Tide, Sanguine Mend and 59 more) is already gated on 802877 in the
client data, so those rows were never built at all and kept the raw red $?a524861 requirement line
while staying usable; their client rows must be rewritten to the internal marker too.

CLIENT ROW: Bloodmoon Blast rank 1 (500125) carries the internal cursed form marker
CONTROL: its tooltip text is rewritten to the internal marker

TEXT: Crimson Tide rank 1 (504129) is rewritten as well
